description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for managing modals related to purchase list operations such as adding, editing, and deleting lists. It sets up event listeners for modal show events and button clicks, and updates form actions and display text dynamically based on user interactions.

methods.name: setEditModal
methods.description: Sets up the edit modal with the selected list's URL and name, and focuses the input field when the modal is shown.

methods.name: setDeleteModal
methods.description: Configures the delete modal with the selected list's URL, name, and item count, updating the display text accordingly.
